properties.text:
The New York Times manufactures consent for genocide. Asymmetrical reporting, and a refusal to call what is happening in Palestine a genocide misleads its readers into believing that “Israel” is justified in the atrocities it commits on a daily basis. Numerous global organizations and world leaders have long been calling this a genocide, and multiple members of the “Israeli” government have been charged with war crimes by the International Criminal Court. 

Today 5/26/25 a small autonomous group of protestors showed up at the headquarters of The New York Times to highlight their lack of ethics in reporting and failure of journalistic integrity. The group marched to Times Square and Bryant park before ending at the NYPL, spreading the message to many tourists and NYC residents. 

New York Times, your hands are red.
